test.q: A protractor's outer scale reads 0 on one ray of an angle and 35 on the other ray. What is the angle?
What angle do the hands of a clock form at 6:00?
Explain why angles that fill a full turn add to 360 degrees.
test.ans: A full turn is a whole circle, and a circle is measured as 360 one-degree angles. Angles that fill the full turn without overlapping must add to 360 degrees.

test.q: Rory says a triangle with three 60-degree angles is a right triangle because all its angles are the same. Explain his mistake.
test.ans: A right triangle must have one 90-degree angle. All of these angles are 60 degrees, less than 90, so the triangle is acute (and equilateral), not right.

test.q: Describe a quadrilateral with exactly 2 lines of symmetry and 4 right angles. Explain how you know it has exactly 2 lines of symmetry.
test.ans: A rectangle that is not a square, such as 3 by 6. Folding it across the middle in either direction makes the halves match, but folding on a diagonal does not, so it has exactly 2 lines of symmetry.

test.q: Sofia designs a pinwheel with 5 blades that meet at a center point. The angles between the blades fill a full turn. Four of the angles measure 70, 80, 65 and 75 degrees. (a) Write and solve an equation to find the fifth angle. (b) Classify each of the five angles as acute, right or obtuse. (c) For a new pinwheel, she wants 4 blades with 4 equal angles between them. What is each angle, and what kind of angle is it? (d) Explain how you would check one angle of the first design with a protractor.
rub: (a) 70 + 80 + 65 + 75 + x = 360, x = 70 degrees; (b) all five are acute; (c) 360 / 4 = 90 degrees, right angles; (d) correct protractor steps (center on vertex, one ray on 0, read the same scale).
All parts correct with a gap in the equation or explanation, or one small error.
Two parts correct, or the fifth angle found with a calculation error.
Little correct work.

units.name: Module 5: Fraction equivalence, ordering and operations
units.el: Give each student fraction strips and a number line from 0 to 3. Pre-teach "equivalent", "decompose", "mixed number", "benchmark", "numerator" and "denominator", and post the frame "___ fourths plus ___ fourths is ___ fourths."

lessons.name: Decomposing fractions and finding equivalent fractions

practice.q: Which shows 3/5 decomposed into unit fractions?
practice.h: A unit fraction has a numerator of 1.

practice.q: 2/3 = ?/12. What is the missing numerator?
practice.h: What do you multiply 3 by to get 12? Multiply the numerator by the same number.

practice.q: Which fraction is equivalent to 9/12?
practice.h: Divide the numerator and the denominator by the same number.

practice.q: 5/10 = 1/?. What is the missing denominator?
practice.h: What number do you divide 5 by to get 1?

practice.q: Which is NOT a way to decompose 5/8?
practice.h: Add each set of parts. Which one does not make 5/8?

practice.q: Use an area model to explain why 1/4 = 3/12.
practice.ans: Draw a rectangle cut into 4 equal parts and shade 1 part. Cut each part into 3 equal pieces. Now there are 12 pieces and 3 are shaded, but the shaded amount did not change, so 1/4 = 3/12.

quiz.q: 3/4 = ?/100. What is the missing numerator?
Which fraction is equivalent to 4/6?
12/16 = 3/?. What is the missing denominator?
Which equation shows 7/10 decomposed correctly?
A garden has 12 equal beds. Flowers grow in 2/3 of the beds. How many beds have flowers?
Which list shows only fractions equivalent to 1/2?
Jay says 2/3 = 3/4 because he added 1 to the numerator and to the denominator. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: Adding the same number does not make an equivalent fraction; you must multiply or divide the numerator and denominator by the same number. 2/3 = 8/12 and 3/4 = 9/12, so they are not equal.

lessons.name: Comparing fractions

practice.q: Which symbol makes 3/8 __ 1/2 true?
practice.h: 1/2 is the same as 4/8.

practice.q: Which fraction is greater than 1/2?
practice.h: Compare each numerator with half of its denominator.

practice.q: Which comparison is true?
practice.h: Rename both fractions with a denominator of 15.

practice.q: Kiran ran 5/6 mile and Ali ran 7/12 mile. How much farther did Kiran run, in miles?
practice.h: Rename 5/6 as twelfths first.

practice.q: Order from least to greatest: 3/4, 5/8, 7/12
practice.h: Rename all three fractions with a denominator of 24.

practice.q: Explain how to use 1/2 as a benchmark to compare 3/7 and 5/9.
practice.ans: 3/7 is less than 1/2 because 3 is less than half of 7. 5/9 is more than 1/2 because 5 is more than half of 9. So 3/7 < 5/9.

quiz.q: Which fraction is less than 1/2?
Which symbol makes 5/6 __ 7/9 true?
Which fraction is greatest?
Ming used 3/4 cup of milk and Tess used 5/8 cup of milk. How many more cups did Ming use?
Lena says 4/5 > 5/6 because 4/5 is closer to 1. Which statement is correct?
ch: She is wrong: 4/5 is 1/5 away from 1 and 5/6 is 1/6 away, so 5/6 is closer to 1 and greater
She is right, because fifths are bigger than sixths

quiz.q: Ava ran 2/3 mile, Ben ran 5/6 mile and Cal ran 7/12 mile. How much farther did the person who ran the most go than the person who ran the least, in miles?
Explain why 1/2 of one pizza and 1/3 of another pizza can only be compared fairly if the pizzas are the same size.
quiz.ans: Fractions name parts of a whole. If the wholes are different sizes, 1/3 of a very big pizza could be more than 1/2 of a small one, so the wholes must be the same to compare the fractions.

lessons.name: Adding and subtracting fractions with like denominators

practice.h: Add the number of sevenths. The size of the pieces does not change.
Subtract the number of tenths.
1 whole is 8/8.

practice.q: Which sum is equal to 5/6?
practice.h: Add the sixths in each choice.

practice.q: A pitcher has 7/8 liter of juice. Sam pours 3/8 liter into one glass and 2/8 liter into another. How many liters are left in the pitcher?
practice.h: Add the amounts poured first, or subtract one amount at a time.

practice.q: Explain why 3/5 + 1/5 is 4/5 and not 4/10.
practice.ans: The pieces are fifths. 3 fifths plus 1 fifth is 4 fifths. The denominator names the size of the pieces, and that size does not change when you add.

quiz.q: Mia walked 5/8 mile to the park and then 2/8 mile to the store. How far did she walk in all?
A class ate 2/12 of a tray of pizza at lunch and 5/12 of it after school. What fraction of the tray is left?
Which sum makes exactly 1 whole?
Theo wrote 5/9 - 2/9 = 3/0. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: He subtracted the denominators. The pieces are still ninths, so only the numerators are subtracted: 5/9 - 2/9 = 3/9.

lessons.name: Mixed numbers: renaming, adding and subtracting

practice.q: Which is 11/4 written as a mixed number?
practice.h: How many groups of 4/4 are in 11/4? How many fourths are left?

practice.q: Write 3 2/5 as a fraction greater than 1.
practice.h: Each whole is 5/5. How many fifths are in 3 wholes?
Add the wholes, then add the eighths.
There are not enough sixths to subtract. Rename 1 whole as 6/6.

practice.q: Which equals 5 1/3 - 2 2/3?
practice.h: Rename 5 1/3 as 4 4/3 first.

practice.q: Explain two ways to solve 3 3/4 + 1 2/4.
practice.ans: Add wholes and parts: 4 + 5/4 = 4 + 1 1/4 = 5 1/4. Or change both to fractions: 15/4 + 6/4 = 21/4 = 5 1/4.

quiz.q: Which fraction equals 3 5/6?
A board is 5 2/8 feet long. Jo cuts off 1 7/8 feet. How many feet long is the board now?
Mr. Diaz ran 2 3/4 miles on Monday and 3 2/4 miles on Tuesday. His goal for the week is 8 miles. How many more miles must he run?
Which sum is greater than 6?
Kara says 2 1/4 - 1 3/4 = 1 2/4 because 3/4 - 1/4 = 2/4. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: She subtracted the fractions in the wrong order. She needs to rename 2 1/4 as 1 5/4. Then 1 5/4 - 1 3/4 = 2/4.

lessons.name: Multiplying a fraction by a whole number and fraction line plots

practice.h: Think of 4 groups of 1 fifth.
3 groups of 2 sevenths is how many sevenths?
5 groups of 3 fourths is 15 fourths.

practice.q: Which is equal to 3/8 + 3/8 + 3/8 + 3/8?
practice.h: How many groups of 3/8 are added?

practice.q: A recipe uses 2/3 cup of oats for one batch. How many cups of oats are needed for 6 batches?
practice.h: Find 6 x 2/3, then rename the answer as a whole number.

practice.q: Use a number line to explain why 6 x 2/5 = 12/5.
practice.ans: Make 6 jumps of 2/5 from 0: 2/5, 4/5, 6/5, 8/5, 10/5, 12/5. Six groups of 2 fifths is 12 fifths, which is 2 2/5.

quiz.q: Each student needs 3/4 yard of ribbon. How many yards of ribbon do 8 students need?
A line plot shows the lengths of 6 pencils: 2 at 4 1/4 inches, 3 at 4 2/4 inches and 1 at 4 3/4 inches. What is the difference between the longest and shortest pencils, in inches?
A line plot shows daily rainfall: 3 days with 1/8 inch, 2 days with 3/8 inch and 1 day with 5/8 inch. What was the total rainfall for those days, in inches?
Which product is greater than 3?
Nico says 3 x 2/5 = 6/15. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: He multiplied the denominator too. 3 x 2/5 means 3 groups of 2 fifths, which is 6 fifths, or 6/5. The pieces are still fifths.

test.q: Which fraction is equivalent to 2/5?
Which is 9/4 written as a mixed number?
Which comparison of 3/5 and 2/3 is true?
Which fraction is equivalent to 60/100?
Which list is in order from greatest to least?
Which is the same as 4 x 2/9?
A water bottle holds 3/4 liter. Ella drinks 5 full bottles on a hike. How many liters does she drink?
Raj has a rope 6 feet long. He uses 1 3/8 feet and then 2 6/8 feet. How many feet of rope are left?
Maria practiced piano for 3/4 hour each day for 6 days. Her goal was 5 hours. How many more hours does she need?
Which fraction is between 1/2 and 3/4?
Sam ate 3/8 of a pizza and Kim ate 1/4 of the same pizza. What fraction of the pizza is left?
A line plot shows 4 beetles that are each 3/4 inch long and 2 beetles that are each 1 1/4 inches long. What is the total length of all 6 beetles, in inches?
Which equation shows 7/8 decomposed correctly?
Use a model to explain why 2/3 = 8/12.
test.ans: Shade 2 of 3 equal parts of a bar. Split each third into 4 equal pieces. Now there are 12 pieces and 8 are shaded, and the shaded amount is the same, so 2/3 = 8/12.

test.q: Leah says 2/5 + 2/5 = 4/10. Explain her mistake and give the correct sum.
test.ans: She added the denominators. The pieces are fifths, so 2 fifths + 2 fifths = 4 fifths, or 4/5.

test.q: Compare 5/8 and 4/6 using two different strategies.
test.ans: Common denominators: 5/8 = 15/24 and 4/6 = 16/24, so 5/8 < 4/6. Distance from 1: 5/8 is 3/8 away from 1 and 4/6 is 2/6, or 1/3, away; 3/8 is more than 1/3, so 5/8 is farther from 1 and is the smaller fraction.

test.q: Ms. Park's class is making smoothies. Each smoothie uses 3/4 cup of yogurt, 2/4 cup of berries and 1/4 cup of juice. (a) How many cups of ingredients are in one smoothie? Write your answer as a mixed number. (b) The class makes 8 smoothies. How many cups of each ingredient are needed? (c) Yogurt comes in tubs that hold 4 cups. How many tubs must the class buy, and how much yogurt will be left over? Show your work with equations or models and explain each step.
rub: (a) 6/4 = 1 2/4 cups; (b) yogurt 8 x 3/4 = 6 cups, berries 8 x 2/4 = 4 cups, juice 8 x 1/4 = 2 cups; (c) 2 tubs, with 2 cups left over; clear equations or models for every step.
All parts correct with gaps in the work, or one small error with clear reasoning.
One or two parts correct, or multiplies the denominators.
Little correct work.

units.name: Module 6: Decimal fractions
units.el: Use meter sticks, 10-by-10 grids and play money to show tenths and hundredths. Pre-teach "tenth", "hundredth", "decimal point" and "equivalent", and read decimals aloud both ways ("zero point four" and "four tenths").

lessons.name: Tenths as fractions and decimals

practice.q: Which decimal equals 3/10?
practice.h: The first place to the right of the decimal point is the tenths place.

practice.q: Write 7/10 as a decimal.
practice.h: How many tenths are there?

practice.q: A meter stick is marked in 10 equal parts. A ribbon starts at 0 and reaches the 6th mark. How long is the ribbon?
practice.h: Each part is 1 tenth of a meter.

practice.q: Write 2 4/10 as a decimal.
practice.h: The whole number goes to the left of the decimal point.

practice.q: Where is 1.5 on a number line?
practice.h: 1.5 is 1 whole and 5 tenths.

practice.q: Explain why 0.8 and 8/10 name the same number.
practice.ans: 0.8 means 8 tenths, because the 8 is in the tenths place. 8/10 also means 8 tenths, so they are the same number.

quiz.q: Write 9/10 as a decimal.
Which fraction equals 0.4?
Write 5 3/10 as a decimal.
A 1-liter bottle has 10 equal marks. Lou fills it to the 7th mark. How many liters are in the bottle?
A rope is cut into pieces that are each 1/10 meter long. Jo uses 13 of the pieces. How many meters of rope does she use?
Which number is 1 tenth more than 3.9?
Pia says 0.5 and 5 are the same because they both have a 5. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: The 5 in 0.5 is in the tenths place, so it means 5 tenths, which is half of one whole. The 5 in 5 is in the ones place, so it means 5 wholes.

lessons.name: Hundredths and equivalent decimals

practice.q: Which decimal equals 45/100?
practice.h: The second place to the right of the decimal point is the hundredths place.

practice.q: 3/10 = ?/100. What is the missing numerator?
practice.h: Each tenth is 10 hundredths.

practice.q: Write 6/100 as a decimal.
practice.h: 6 hundredths has no tenths. What digit goes in the tenths place?

practice.q: Which decimal is equal to 0.7?
practice.h: 7 tenths is how many hundredths?

practice.q: 4/10 + 25/100 = ? Write the answer as a fraction with a denominator of 100.
practice.h: Rename 4/10 as hundredths first.

practice.q: Explain why 0.50 has the same value as 0.5.
practice.ans: 0.5 is 5 tenths. Each tenth is 10 hundredths, so 5 tenths = 50 hundredths = 0.50. The zero in the hundredths place adds no value.

quiz.q: Write 83/100 as a decimal.
Which fraction equals 0.09?
60/100 = ?/10. What is the missing numerator?
Which decimal is 3 ones and 7 hundredths?
2/10 + 54/100 = ? Write the answer as a decimal.
A grid has 100 equal squares. Kai shades 3 full columns of 10 squares and 8 more squares. What decimal names the shaded part of the grid?
Ali wrote 0.6 as 6/100. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: 0.6 is 6 tenths, not 6 hundredths. 6 tenths = 6/10, which is the same as 60/100.

lessons.name: Comparing decimals

practice.q: Which symbol makes 0.6 __ 0.45 true?
practice.h: Rename 0.6 as hundredths.

practice.q: Which decimal is greatest?
practice.h: Compare the tenths digits first.

practice.q: Order from least to greatest: 0.3, 0.27, 0.32
practice.h: Write each decimal as hundredths: 30, 27 and 32 hundredths.

practice.q: Which is greater, 1.4 or 1.38? Write the greater number.
practice.h: Both have 1 whole. Compare the tenths.

practice.q: One snail crawled 0.5 m and another crawled 0.48 m. Which statement is true?
ch: The first snail crawled 2 hundredths of a meter farther
The first snail crawled 43 hundredths of a meter farther
practice.h: Write both distances as hundredths of a meter.

practice.q: Explain how a meter stick can show that 0.7 m is longer than 0.65 m.
practice.ans: 0.7 m is 70 cm and 0.65 m is 65 cm. On a meter stick, 70 cm is farther from 0 than 65 cm, so 0.7 m is longer.

quiz.q: Which comparison is true?
Which decimal is less than 0.5?
Order from greatest to least: 2.1, 2.09, 2.19
Four frogs jumped 1.25 m, 1.3 m, 1.07 m and 1.2 m. How many meters did the frog that jumped farthest go?
Which digit makes 0._4 > 0.65 true?
What decimal is halfway between 0.3 and 0.4?
Sam says 0.25 > 0.3 because 25 is greater than 3. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: He compared 25 and 3 as whole numbers. 0.3 is 30 hundredths, which is more than 25 hundredths, so 0.25 < 0.3.

lessons.name: Adding tenths and hundredths and money amounts

practice.q: 3/10 + 45/100 = ? Write the answer as a decimal.
practice.h: Rename 3/10 as 30/100.

practice.q: Write 65 cents as a decimal number of dollars.
practice.h: A dollar is 100 cents, so 1 cent is 1 hundredth of a dollar.

practice.q: What is the value of 3 quarters and 2 dimes, in dollars?
practice.h: A quarter is 25 cents and a dime is 10 cents.

practice.q: 2 3/10 + 1 46/100 = ? Write the answer as a decimal.
practice.h: Add the wholes, then rename the tenths as hundredths and add.

practice.q: Kim has 2 one-dollar bills, 3 dimes and 4 pennies. How many dollars does she have, written as a decimal?
practice.h: Find the cents first: 3 dimes and 4 pennies.

practice.q: Explain why 6/10 + 7/100 is not 13/110.
practice.ans: You cannot add the denominators. Rename 6/10 as 60/100, then 60/100 + 7/100 = 67/100, or 0.67.

quiz.q: 5/10 + 32/100 = ? Write the answer as a decimal.
Write 3 dollars and 8 cents as a decimal number of dollars.
A pencil costs $0.45 and an eraser costs $0.30. What is the total cost in dollars?
Which coins have a total value of exactly 1 dollar?
Ana walks 4/10 km to school, 25/100 km to the library and 2/10 km home. How many kilometers does she walk in all? Write the answer as a decimal.
Which sum equals 1?
Jae says $1.5 is the same as 1 dollar and 5 cents. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: $1.5 means 1 dollar and 5 tenths of a dollar. 5 tenths of a dollar is 50 cents, so $1.5 = $1.50, not $1.05.

test.q: Which decimal equals 6/10?
Write 47/100 as a decimal.
What is the value of the 3 in 0.53?
8/10 = ?/100. What is the missing numerator?
Which of these decimals has the greatest value?
Which decimal is equal to 2 5/100?
7/10 + 15/100 = ? Write the answer as a decimal.
Which statement about 0.9 and 0.89 is true?
Order from least to greatest: 1.5, 1.05, 1.45
Write 9 dollars and 25 cents as a decimal number of dollars.
One ribbon is 0.6 m long and another is 0.35 m long. What is their total length in meters?
Leo has 3 quarters, 1 dime and 3 pennies. How many dollars does he have, written as a decimal?
A plant grew 3/10 cm in week 1, 45/100 cm in week 2 and 15/100 cm in week 3. How many centimeters did it grow in all? Write the answer as a decimal.
A 1-liter jar has 25/100 liter of water in it. Mo adds 6/10 liter more. How many more liters are needed to fill the jar? Write the answer as a decimal.
Which number is closest to 1 on a number line?
Mia ran 1.4 km, Jon ran 1.35 km and Tai ran 1.04 km. Which statement is true?
ch: Mia ran the farthest and Tai ran the shortest distance

test.q: Which fraction equals 0.2?
Which number is 1 hundredth more than 0.39?
Explain how a number line from 0 to 1 shows that 0.3 = 0.30.
test.ans: Split the line into 10 tenths; 0.3 is at the 3rd mark. Split each tenth into 10 hundredths; the 30th hundredth mark is at the same point. Numbers at the same point are equal.

test.q: Kayla says 0.07 > 0.7 because 7 hundredths sounds bigger than 7 tenths. Explain her mistake.
test.ans: Hundredths are smaller pieces than tenths. 0.7 = 70 hundredths, which is more than 7 hundredths, so 0.7 > 0.07.

test.q: Write 2.46 in expanded form in two ways, once with decimals and once with fractions. Explain the value of each digit.
test.ans: 2 + 0.4 + 0.06 and 2 + 4/10 + 6/100. The 2 is 2 ones, the 4 is 4 tenths and the 6 is 6 hundredths.

test.q: The school snack cart sells apples for $0.45, juice for $0.75 and muffins for $1.20. (a) Write each price as a fraction or mixed number of a dollar. (b) Order the prices from least to greatest. (c) What is the cost of one apple, one juice and one muffin together? (d) Ramon has 2 one-dollar bills, 1 quarter and 2 dimes. Can he buy one of each item? Explain how much money he would have left or how much more he would need.
rub: (a) 45/100, 75/100 and 1 20/100; (b) $0.45, $0.75, $1.20; (c) $2.40; (d) Ramon has $2.45, so he can buy all three with $0.05 left; clear work with hundredths and a complete explanation.
All parts correct with gaps in explanation, or one small error with clear work.
Two parts correct, or decimal place value errors in several parts.
Little correct work.

units.name: Module 7: Exploring measurement with multiplication
units.el: Post a customary conversion chart (feet and inches, yards and feet, pounds and ounces, gallons, quarts, pints and cups, hours and minutes) and show real rulers, yardsticks and measuring cups. Pre-teach "convert", "ounce", "pint", "quart" and "gallon".

lessons.name: Customary length and conversion tables

practice.q: How many inches are in 1 foot?
practice.h: Look at a 12-inch ruler.

practice.q: How many feet are in 1 yard?
practice.h: Think about a yardstick and a 1-foot ruler.

practice.q: How many inches are in 5 feet?
practice.h: Each foot is 12 inches.

practice.q: A table shows 1 ft = 12 in, 2 ft = 24 in and 3 ft = 36 in. Which rule changes feet to inches?
practice.h: What do you do to 1, 2 and 3 to get 12, 24 and 36?

practice.q: How many inches are in 4 feet 7 inches?
practice.h: Convert the feet to inches, then add the extra inches.

practice.q: Explain why the number of inches is always 12 times the number of feet for the same length.
practice.ans: Each foot is made of 12 inches. If a length is some number of feet, it is that many groups of 12 inches.

quiz.q: How many feet are in 6 yards?
How many inches are in 1 yard?
Which length is the longest?
A bookshelf is 3 feet 9 inches tall. How many inches tall is it?
A ribbon is 4 yards long. Nia cuts it into pieces that are each 2 feet long. How many pieces does she get?
Which length is equal to 50 inches?
Ray says 3 feet = 36 feet because 3 x 12 = 36. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: 3 feet equals 36 inches, not 36 feet. He changed the number correctly but forgot that the unit changes to inches.

lessons.name: Converting weight, liquid volume and time

practice.q: How many ounces are in 1 pound?
practice.h: A pound is a larger unit made of 16 smaller units.

practice.q: How many cups are in 1 quart?
practice.h: 1 quart = 2 pints and 1 pint = 2 cups.

practice.q: How many ounces are in 3 pounds?
practice.h: Multiply the pounds by 16.

practice.q: How many minutes are in 4 hours?
practice.h: Each hour is 60 minutes.

practice.q: Which is equal to 2 gallons?
practice.h: 1 gallon = 4 quarts.

practice.q: Make a table for 1, 2, 3 and 4 gallons in quarts and explain the pattern.
practice.ans: 1 gallon = 4 quarts, 2 = 8, 3 = 12 and 4 = 16 quarts. Each gallon adds 4 quarts, so the quarts are always 4 times the gallons.

quiz.q: How many pints are in 1 quart?
How many ounces are in 5 pounds 3 ounces?
How many seconds are in 3 minutes?
Which weight is the heaviest?
A recipe needs 3 quarts of milk. Milk is sold in 1-pint bottles. How many bottles are needed?
A movie is 2 hours 15 minutes long. How many minutes long is it?
Tess says 1 gallon is less than 10 cups because 1 is less than 10. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: She compared numbers with different units. 1 gallon = 4 quarts = 16 cups, which is more than 10 cups.

lessons.name: Measurement word problems with mixed units

practice.q: Ari's puppy weighed 4 pounds 10 ounces. It gained 2 pounds 9 ounces. How many ounces does it weigh now?
practice.h: Convert both weights to ounces, or add pounds and ounces separately and regroup.

practice.q: A board is 8 feet long. Two pieces that are each 2 feet 9 inches long are cut from it. How many inches of the board are left?
practice.h: Change all the lengths to inches first.

practice.q: 3 hours 40 minutes + 1 hour 35 minutes = ?
practice.h: 40 + 35 minutes is more than 60 minutes. Make a new hour.

practice.q: Ms. Ray buys 3 gallons of juice. She serves 30 cups. How many cups of juice are left?
practice.h: Change the gallons to cups. 1 gallon = 16 cups.

practice.q: A runner trains for 45 minutes each day for 6 days. How many minutes does she train in all?
practice.h: Multiply the minutes for one day by the number of days.

practice.q: Explain two ways to solve 5 feet 3 inches - 2 feet 8 inches.
practice.ans: Convert to inches: 63 - 32 = 31 inches, which is 2 feet 7 inches. Or rename 1 foot as 12 inches: 4 feet 15 inches - 2 feet 8 inches = 2 feet 7 inches.

quiz.q: One box of books weighs 12 pounds 6 ounces. A second box weighs 9 pounds 13 ounces. How many ounces heavier is the first box?
6 feet 4 inches - 3 feet 9 inches = ?
A school play rehearses for 1 hour 20 minutes on Monday. On Wednesday it rehearses twice as long as on Monday. How many minutes does it rehearse on the two days?
A cooler holds 5 gallons of lemonade. Each serving is 1 cup. How many servings does the cooler hold?
Jada is 4 feet 6 inches tall. Her dad is 6 feet 1 inch tall. How many inches taller is her dad?
Each of 4 bags weighs 2 pounds 5 ounces. Which is a correct way to find the total weight?
Omar added 2 hours 45 minutes + 1 hour 30 minutes and wrote 3 hours 75 minutes. Is his answer correct? Explain a better way to write it.
quiz.ans: The amount is correct, but 75 minutes is more than 1 hour. 75 minutes = 1 hour 15 minutes, so the total is better written as 4 hours 15 minutes.

lessons.name: Measurements as fractions and mixed numbers

practice.q: What fraction of a foot is 6 inches?
practice.h: A foot has 12 inches. What part of 12 is 6?

practice.q: How many inches are in 2 1/2 feet?
practice.h: Half of a foot is 6 inches.

practice.q: How many ounces are in 1/4 pound?
practice.h: Split 16 ounces into 4 equal parts.

practice.q: How many minutes are in 3/4 hour?
practice.h: Find 1/4 of 60 minutes first.

practice.q: Which is equal to 1 1/2 gallons?
practice.h: 1 gallon is 4 quarts. What is half of a gallon?

practice.q: One loaf of bread uses 3/4 cup of milk. How many cups of milk are needed for 8 loaves?
practice.h: Multiply 8 x 3/4 and rename the answer.

practice.q: Explain why 1/3 yard is the same length as 1 foot.
practice.ans: A yard is 3 feet. Splitting a yard into 3 equal parts makes each part 1 foot, so 1/3 yard = 1 foot.

quiz.q: How many inches are in 3/4 foot?
How many minutes are in 2 1/4 hours?
A trail is 2 3/4 miles long. Kim walks the trail 4 times. How far does she walk?
A bag of apples weighs 1 1/4 pounds. How many ounces does it weigh?
Each of 6 students drinks 1/2 quart of water. How many cups of water do they drink altogether?
Which of these lengths is the longest?
Lu says 1/2 hour is 50 minutes because half of 100 is 50. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: An hour has 60 minutes, not 100. Half of 60 is 30, so 1/2 hour is 30 minutes.

test.q: How many inches are in 3 feet?
How many ounces are in 2 pounds?

How many minutes are in 2 hours?

test.ans: Multiply the feet by 12: 3 x 12 = 36 inches. Then add the 4 extra inches: 36 + 4 = 40 inches.

test.q: Zara subtracted 5 pounds 2 ounces - 1 pound 8 ounces and got 4 pounds 6 ounces. Explain her mistake and find the correct answer.
test.ans: She subtracted 2 from 8 instead of renaming. Rename 1 pound as 16 ounces: 4 pounds 18 ounces - 1 pound 8 ounces = 3 pounds 10 ounces.

test.q: Use yards and feet to explain why changing from a larger unit to a smaller unit uses multiplication.
test.ans: Each yard is made of 3 feet, so a number of yards is that many groups of 3 feet. For example, 4 yards = 4 x 3 = 12 feet. It takes more of the smaller unit to make the same length.

test.q: The class is building a rectangular garden bed that is 3 yards long and 5 feet wide. (a) Find the perimeter of the bed in feet. (b) Border boards come in 4-foot lengths. How many boards are needed to go all the way around? (c) Find the area of the bed in square feet. (d) Each square foot needs 1/2 pound of plant food. Plant food is sold in 5-pound bags. How many bags must the class buy? Show your conversions and explain each step.
rub: (a) 3 yards = 9 feet, perimeter 2 x 9 + 2 x 5 = 28 feet; (b) 28 / 4 = 7 boards; (c) 9 x 5 = 45 square feet; (d) 45 x 1/2 = 22 1/2 pounds, so 5 bags (25 pounds); conversions shown and each step explained.

math|5.about: Fifth grade extends place value to thousandths and powers of ten, computes fluently with multi-digit whole numbers and decimals to hundredths, adds and subtracts fractions with unlike denominators, multiplies and divides with fractions, measures volume and area with fractional side lengths, and graphs points on the coordinate plane to solve problems.
std: Recognize that in a multi-digit number, a digit in one place represents 10 times as much as it represents in the place to its right and 1/10 of what it represents in the place to its left.
Fluently multiply multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.
Add, subtract, multiply and divide decimals to hundredths using models, place value strategies and properties of operations.
Add and subtract fractions with unlike denominators, including mixed numbers, by replacing them with equivalent fractions.
Multiply a fraction or whole number by a fraction.
Divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions.
Relate volume to multiplication and addition and solve real-world problems involving volume.
Represent real-world and mathematical problems by graphing points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane.

units.name: Module 1: Place value and decimal fractions
units.el: Keep a place value chart from thousands to thousandths on each desk. Pre-teach "exponent", "power of ten", "thousandths" and "round", and read decimals aloud with place names ("four and twenty-six hundredths").

lessons.name: Multiplying and dividing by powers of ten

practice.h: When you multiply by 10, each digit moves one place to the left.
Dividing by 100 moves each digit two places to the right.

practice.q: Which is equal to 10^3?

practice.h: How many places does each digit move when you multiply by 1,000?

practice.q: In 4.44, the 4 in the ones place is how many times the value of the 4 in the tenths place?
practice.h: Each place is 10 times the place to its right.

practice.q: Explain why 2.5 x 10^2 = 250.
practice.ans: 10^2 = 100. Multiplying by 100 makes each digit 100 times as large, so each digit shifts two places to the left: 2 ones become 2 hundreds and 5 tenths become 5 tens, which is 250.

quiz.q: What is 7 x 10^4?
Which is the same as 4,200 / 10^2?
One pencil costs $0.35. How many dollars do 100 pencils cost?
The value of the 6 in 0.06 is what fraction of the value of the 6 in 6?
Lea says 3.2 x 10 = 3.20 because you just add a zero. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: Writing a zero at the end of a decimal does not change its value: 3.20 = 3.2. Multiplying by 10 makes each digit 10 times as large and moves it one place to the left, so 3.2 x 10 = 32.

lessons.name: Reading, writing and comparing decimals to thousandths

practice.q: Which is the word form of 4.208?
ch: four and two hundred eight thousandths
four and two hundred eight hundredths
practice.h: The last digit is in the thousandths place.

practice.q: Which shows 3.072 in expanded form?
practice.h: Name the place of each digit first.

practice.q: Which symbol makes 0.405 __ 0.45 true?
practice.h: Compare the hundredths digits: 0 hundredths and 5 hundredths.

practice.q: Write 6 + 0.3 + 0.009 as a decimal.
practice.h: There are no hundredths. What digit goes in the hundredths place?

practice.q: Order from least to greatest: 2.31, 2.103, 2.13
practice.h: All three have 2 ones. Compare the tenths, then the hundredths.

practice.q: Explain why 0.7 > 0.698 even though 0.698 has more digits.
practice.ans: Compare place by place, starting with the greatest place. 0.7 has 7 tenths and 0.698 has only 6 tenths, so 0.7 is greater. The number of digits does not decide the size.

quiz.q: Write five and forty-six thousandths as a decimal.
What is the value of the 9 in 3.429?
Which decimal is greatest?
Which number is equal to 4/10 + 3/1000?
Three runners finished a race in 12.08 seconds, 12.8 seconds and 12.008 seconds. What was the fastest time, in seconds?
Which digit makes 1.4_7 < 1.437 true?
Ty wrote 2 + 0.5 + 0.08 as 2.508. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: 0.08 is 8 hundredths, so the 8 belongs in the hundredths place, not the thousandths place. The number is 2.58.

lessons.name: Rounding decimals

practice.q: Round 3.47 to the nearest tenth.
practice.h: Look at the hundredths digit.

practice.q: Round 12.649 to the nearest hundredth.
practice.h: Look at the thousandths digit.

practice.q: Round 7.952 to the nearest tenth.
practice.h: 7.952 is between 7.9 and 8.0. Which is it closer to?

practice.q: Round 0.385 to the nearest hundredth.
practice.h: 0.385 is exactly halfway between 0.38 and 0.39.

practice.q: Which number rounds to 4.6 when rounded to the nearest tenth?
practice.h: Numbers from 4.55 up to, but not including, 4.65 round to 4.6.

practice.q: Explain how a number line helps you round 2.738 to the nearest hundredth.
practice.ans: 2.738 is between 2.73 and 2.74, and the halfway point is 2.735. 2.738 is past the halfway point, so it rounds to 2.74.

quiz.q: Round 5.62 to the nearest whole number.
Round 9.035 to the nearest hundredth.
A runner's time is 15.468 seconds. What is the time rounded to the nearest tenth?
Which number does NOT round to 3 when rounded to the nearest whole number?
A bag of rice costs $2.89 and a jar of beans costs $3.15. Estimate the total cost by rounding each price to the nearest dollar. What is the estimate in dollars?
A number with three decimal places rounds to 0.5 when rounded to the nearest tenth. Which of these is the greatest the number could be?
Kim rounded 6.97 to the nearest tenth and wrote 6.10. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: 6.97 is between 6.9 and 7.0 and is past halfway, so it rounds up. One more tenth than 9 tenths is 10 tenths, which is 1 whole, so the answer is 7.0, not 6.10.

lessons.name: Adding and subtracting decimals

practice.h: Line up the decimal points. You can write 4.7 as 4.70.
Write 6.2 as 6.20 before you subtract.
Write 12.06 as 12.060 so both numbers have thousandths.
Write 10 as 10.00 and rename.

practice.q: Which is the best estimate for 8.92 + 3.1?
practice.h: Round each number to the nearest whole number.

practice.q: Explain why you line up the decimal points when you add 3.4 + 1.25.
practice.ans: Lining up the decimal points lines up digits with the same place value: ones with ones and tenths with tenths. Then 3.40 + 1.25 = 4.65.

quiz.q: A shirt costs $14.95 and a cap costs $8.50. How many dollars do they cost together?
Rosa had $20. She bought a book for $7.89 and a pen for $1.35. How many dollars does she have left?
A plant was 3.4 cm tall. It grew 0.85 cm. How many centimeters tall is it now?
Which equation is true?
Dan subtracted 7.4 - 2.15 and got 5.35. Explain his mistake and find the correct answer.
quiz.ans: In the hundredths place he subtracted 0 from 5 instead of 5 from 0. He should write 7.4 as 7.40 and rename 1 tenth as 10 hundredths: 7.40 - 2.15 = 5.25.

practice.h: 3 groups of 4 tenths is 12 tenths.

practice.h: Share $6.25 equally into 5 groups.

practice.q: Explain how 4 x 0.3 is related to 4 x 3.
practice.ans: 4 x 3 = 12, so 4 x 3 tenths = 12 tenths. 12 tenths is 1.2, so 4 x 0.3 = 1.2.

quiz.q: Juice costs $1.85 per bottle. Ms. Kaur buys 4 bottles and pays with a $10 bill. How many dollars of change does she get?
A rope 4.8 meters long is cut into 6 equal pieces. How long is each piece?
Noor divided 2.4 / 3 and got 8. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: 2.4 is 24 tenths, and 24 tenths / 3 = 8 tenths, which is 0.8, not 8. Also, the answer cannot be greater than 2.4 when you divide 2.4 into 3 equal parts.

test.q: What is the value of the 4 in 2.649?
Which is equal to 6.2 x 10^3?
Which decimal has the least value?

Which shows 5.064 in expanded form?
A runner ran 3.75 km on Monday, 4.2 km on Tuesday and 5.05 km on Wednesday. How many kilometers did she run in all?
A school buys 6 boxes of tissues for $2.35 each and pays with a $20 bill. How many dollars of change does it get?
Four friends share a $25.80 pizza bill equally. How many dollars does each friend pay?
A tank holds 50 liters. It has 23.65 liters of water, and then 8.4 liters are added. How many more liters are needed to fill the tank?
Which number has 1/10 the value of 0.5?
Which number rounds to 2.5 when rounded to the nearest tenth and to 2.47 when rounded to the nearest hundredth?
Which is the best estimate of 19.87 - 6.12?

test.ans: In 0.3 the 3 is 3 tenths. In 0.03 it is 3 hundredths, which is 1/10 as much, because each place is 1/10 the value of the place to its left.

test.q: Ming says 0.25 x 10 = 0.250. Explain his mistake.
test.ans: Writing a zero at the end does not multiply by 10, because 0.250 = 0.25. Multiplying by 10 shifts each digit one place to the left, so 0.25 x 10 = 2.5.

test.q: Ella says 4.09 > 4.1 because 9 is greater than 1. Use place value to explain whether she is right.
test.ans: She is not right. Both numbers have 4 ones. 4.1 has 1 tenth and 4.09 has 0 tenths, so 4.1 is greater. She compared digits that are in different places.

test.q: A relay team's four runners had times of 13.47, 12.9, 13.05 and 12.86 seconds. (a) What was the team's total time? (b) List the runners' times from fastest to slowest. (c) Round each time to the nearest tenth and add the rounded times. How does the estimate compare with the exact total? (d) Last year's team had a total time of 53.1 seconds. How many seconds faster is this year's team? Show your work and explain each step.
rub: (a) 52.28 seconds; (b) 12.86, 12.9, 13.05, 13.47; (c) 13.5 + 12.9 + 13.1 + 12.9 = 52.4, which is close to 52.28, so the total is reasonable; (d) 53.1 - 52.28 = 0.82 seconds faster; clear place value work.

units.name: Module 2: Multi-digit whole number and decimal fraction operations
units.el: Model each algorithm step by step on grid paper so digits stay in their columns. Pre-teach "expression", "parentheses", "estimate", "quotient", "divisor" and "remainder", and give the frame "I estimate ___ because ___ is close to ___."

practice.h: Work inside the parentheses first, then multiply, then add.

practice.q: Which expression means "add 8 and 7, then multiply by 3"?
practice.h: Parentheses show which step happens first.
4 tens x 3 hundreds = 12 thousands.
Think 25 x 4 = 100, and 16 is 4 x 4.

practice.q: How does the value of 4 x (12 + 9) compare with the value of 12 + 9?
practice.h: You do not need to compute. What does multiplying the sum by 4 do?

practice.ans: 99 is 1 less than 100. 100 x 7 = 700, then take away one 7: 700 - 7 = 693.

quiz.q: Which expression has a value of 30?

quiz.ans: She subtracted first. Multiplication comes before subtraction when there are no parentheses: 4 x 3 = 12, then 20 - 12 = 8.

practice.ans: The second row multiplies 47 by 3 tens, not 3 ones. 47 x 30 = 1,410, which has 0 ones, so the 0 holds the ones place.

quiz.q: A farm ships 145 crates with 36 melons in each crate. How many melons does it ship?

quiz.ans: He found 63 x 5 = 315 and 63 x 4 = 252 and added them, treating the 4 as 4 ones. The 4 is 4 tens, so he needs 63 x 40 = 2,520. 315 + 2,520 = 2,835.

practice.h: Find 24 x 13, then think about how many tenths that is.
36 hundredths x 25 = 900 hundredths.

practice.q: Ribbon costs $1.75 per meter. How many dollars do 12 meters of ribbon cost?
practice.h: Multiply 1.75 by 12, or find 12 x 1 and 12 x 0.75.

practice.q: A runner runs 2.75 km each day for 14 days. How many kilometers does she run in all?
practice.h: Estimate first: about 3 x 14.

practice.q: Explain how you can use 6 x 42 to find 0.6 x 42.

quiz.q: A bag of apples has a mass of 2.4 kg. How many grams is that?

Find the largest multiple of 24 that is not more than 395.

practice.ans: Multiply the quotient by the divisor: 89 x 26 = 2,314. Since the product equals the dividend, the quotient is correct.

quiz.q: 615 students go to a game in buses that each hold 48 students. How many buses are needed?
A factory packs 1,000 marbles into bags of 35. How many marbles are left over after it fills as many bags as possible?
Lia divided 756 by 36 and got 20 R36. Explain her mistake and give the correct quotient.
quiz.ans: A remainder must be less than the divisor. A remainder of 36 means one more group of 36 fits. 36 x 21 = 756, so the quotient is 21 with no remainder.

practice.h: 4.8 is 48 tenths. Divide 48 tenths by 12.
7.65 is 765 hundredths.

practice.q: A board 9.6 meters long is cut into 16 equal pieces. How many meters long is each piece?
practice.h: Think 96 tenths / 16.

quiz.q: 18 friends share the cost of a $95.40 gift equally. How many dollars does each friend pay?
A cyclist rides 52.5 km in 15 days, riding the same distance each day. How many kilometers does she ride each day?
Which is the best estimate for 61.2 / 19?
A 2.4-liter jug of juice fills 12 equal cups. How many milliliters are in each cup?
Rafi says 4.2 / 14 = 3. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: 4.2 is 42 tenths, and 42 tenths / 14 = 3 tenths, or 0.3. Also, 4.2 shared into 14 equal parts must be less than 1.

rub: (a) 28 x 12.50 + 4 x 15 = 350 + 60 = $410; (b) 32 people need 3 vans, 3 x 85.50 = $256.50; (c) $666.50 total, $33.50 left; (d) a correct expression such as 28 x 12.50 + 4 x 15 + 3 x 85.50; checks explained.

units.name: Module 3: Addition and subtraction of fractions

Lena hiked 2 3/10 miles in the morning and 1 1/2 miles in the afternoon. Her goal was 5 miles. How many more miles does she need to hike?
Which sum is closest to 4?
Omar says 4 1/3 - 1 2/3 = 3 1/3 because 2/3 - 1/3 = 1/3. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: He subtracted the fractions in the wrong order. He should rename 4 1/3 as 3 4/3. Then 3 4/3 - 1 2/3 = 2 2/3.

test.q: Which fraction is equivalent to 3/4?
Which is 12/18 in simplest form?
Which common denominator can be used to add 2/9 and 1/6?
Which is the best estimate for 4/5 + 5/9?
Which statement about 1/2 + 2/5 is true?
A runner ran 1 3/4 miles, rested, then ran 2 2/3 miles more. How many miles did she run in all?
A water tank was 7/8 full. After the plants were watered, it was 1/3 full. What fraction of the tank was used?
Mr. Ruiz has 5 yards of fabric. He uses 1 1/2 yards for a shirt and 2 1/3 yards for pants. How many yards of fabric are left?
Ava read 1/4 of a book on Monday and 3/8 of the book on Tuesday. What fraction of the book does she have left to read?
Which pair of fractions has a difference of exactly 1/2?
Leo says 2/3 + 1/4 = 3/7. Which check shows his sum is not reasonable?
ch: 2/3 is more than 1/2, so the sum must be more than 1/2, but 3/7 is less than 1/2

test.q: Which expression is equal to 5/12?
Order from least to greatest: 2/3, 5/8, 7/12
Explain why you need a common denominator to add 1/3 and 1/5.
test.ans: Thirds and fifths are different-sized pieces, so you cannot count them together. Rename both as fifteenths: 5/15 + 3/15 = 8/15.

test.q: Rina says 3 1/2 - 1 3/4 = 2 1/4. Explain her mistake and find the correct difference.
test.ans: She subtracted 1/2 from 3/4 instead of renaming. Rename 3 1/2 as 3 2/4 and then as 2 6/4; 2 6/4 - 1 3/4 = 1 3/4.

test.q: Use benchmark fractions to explain whether 3/8 + 2/5 is more or less than 1.
test.ans: 3/8 is less than 1/2 (4/8) and 2/5 is less than 1/2 (2.5/5). Two numbers that are each less than 1/2 add to less than 1, so the sum is less than 1.

test.q: Mia is planning a community garden plot. She plants 1/4 of the plot with tomatoes, 1/3 with beans and 1/6 with peppers. (a) What fraction of the plot is planted? (b) What fraction is not planted? (c) She wants to plant squash in 3/8 of the plot. Is there enough room? If not, how much more space would she need? (d) Show a second way to check your answer to (a), using a model or estimation. Explain each step.
rub: (a) 3/12 + 4/12 + 2/12 = 9/12 = 3/4; (b) 1/4; (c) no, 3/8 is more than 1/4 (2/8), so she needs 1/8 of the plot more; (d) a correct area model or benchmark check; clear explanations.
All parts correct with a gap in the explanation, or one small error with clear work.
Two parts correct, or adds denominators in one part.
Little correct work.

units.name: Module 4: Multiplication and division of fractions and decimal fractions
units.el: Draw tape diagrams and area models for every problem. Pre-teach "of" (as multiply), "scaling", "share equally", "unit fraction" and "how many ___ are in ___", and act out sharing with paper strips.

lessons.name: Fractions as division and fraction line plots

practice.q: 3 pizzas are shared equally by 4 friends. How much pizza does each friend get?
practice.h: Divide the number of pizzas by the number of friends.

practice.q: 7 / 2 = ? Write the answer as a mixed number.
practice.h: How many whole 2s are in 7? What fraction is left?

practice.q: Which division expression is equal to 5/8?
practice.h: A fraction bar means "divided by".

practice.q: 10 yards of ribbon are cut into 4 equal pieces. How many yards long is each piece?
practice.h: Divide 10 by 4 and write the remainder as a fraction.

practice.q: A line plot shows rope lengths: 2 ropes are 1/4 foot, 3 ropes are 1/2 foot and 1 rope is 3/4 foot. All six ropes are joined end to end. How many feet long is the joined rope?
practice.h: Multiply each length by the number of ropes, then add.

practice.q: Use 2 sandwiches shared equally by 3 people to explain why 2 / 3 = 2/3.
practice.ans: Cut each sandwich into thirds, which makes 6 thirds. Each person gets 2 of the 6 thirds, so each person gets 2/3 of a sandwich.

quiz.q: 5 granola bars are shared equally by 6 friends. What fraction of a bar does each friend get?
17 / 5 = ? Write the answer as a mixed number.
Which division expression is the same as 9/4?
A teacher shares 6 liters of paint equally among 8 groups. How many liters of paint does each group get?
Five bags of flour weigh 1/4, 1/2, 1/2, 3/4 and 1 pound. If all the flour were shared equally among the 5 bags, how much would each bag weigh?
13 / 3 = ? Write the answer as a mixed number.
Pat says that when 2 sandwiches are shared equally by 5 people, each person gets 5/2 sandwiches. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: She reversed the division. The sandwiches are divided by the people: 2 / 5 = 2/5 of a sandwich each. 5/2 is more than 2 whole sandwiches each, which is impossible with only 2 sandwiches.

lessons.name: Multiplying a whole number by a fraction

practice.h: Find 1/3 of 12 first, then double it.

practice.q: In a class of 20 students, 3/4 ride the bus. How many students ride the bus?
practice.h: Find 1/4 of 20, then multiply by 3.
5 groups of 2 thirds is how many thirds?

practice.q: Which expression shows 2/5 of 30?
practice.h: "Of" means multiply.

practice.q: Mr. Kim had 48 cookies. He gave 1/4 of them to one class and 1/3 of them to another class. How many cookies are left?
practice.h: Find 1/4 of 48 and 1/3 of 48 first.

practice.q: Explain how a tape diagram shows 3/5 of 25.
practice.ans: Split a bar that stands for 25 into 5 equal parts; each part is 25 / 5 = 5. Three parts are 3 x 5 = 15, so 3/5 of 25 is 15.

quiz.q: A 60-minute class spends 2/5 of its time on math games. How many minutes are NOT spent on games?
Which number equals 3/4 x 16?
Ana earned $36. She saved 2/3 of the money and spent the rest. How many dollars did she spend?
Ty says 2/3 x 9 = 18/27. Explain his mistake and find the product.
quiz.ans: He multiplied the denominator by 9 too. 2/3 x 9 means 2/3 of 9: 9 / 3 = 3 and 2 x 3 = 6. Or (2 x 9) / 3 = 18/3 = 6.

lessons.name: Multiplying fractions by fractions and decimals by decimals

practice.h: Find half of one third.
Multiply the numerators, then multiply the denominators.
4 tenths x 3 tenths = 12 hundredths.
Think 15 tenths x 6 tenths = 90 hundredths.

practice.q: A rug is 3/4 yard long and 1/2 yard wide. What is its area?
practice.h: Area is length times width.

practice.q: Describe an area model for 2/3 x 4/5 and use it to find the product.
practice.ans: Draw a square split into 3 rows and 5 columns, making 15 equal parts. Shade 2 rows and 4 columns; the overlap is 8 parts, so 2/3 x 4/5 = 8/15.

quiz.q: In a class, 2/3 of the students play a sport, and 3/4 of those students play soccer. What fraction of the whole class plays soccer?
A ribbon is 0.75 m long. Lina uses 0.4 of the ribbon. How many meters does she use?
Mia says 0.3 x 0.2 = 0.6. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: 3 tenths x 2 tenths = 6 hundredths, because a tenth of a tenth is a hundredth. So 0.3 x 0.2 = 0.06.

lessons.name: Multiplication as scaling

practice.q: Without multiplying, which product is less than 8?
practice.h: What happens when you multiply by a number less than 1?

practice.q: Which statement about 2/3 x 15 is true?
practice.h: 2/3 is less than 1.

practice.q: A photo 4 inches wide is enlarged to 1 1/2 times its width. How many inches wide is the new photo?
practice.h: 1 1/2 times 4 is 4 plus half of 4.

practice.q: Which is greater, 7/8 x 12 or 9/8 x 12?
practice.h: Compare 7/8 and 9/8 with 1.

practice.q: A recipe uses 2 1/2 cups of flour. Ken makes 3/4 of the recipe. How many cups of flour does he use?
practice.h: Write 2 1/2 as 5/2, then multiply by 3/4.

practice.q: Explain why 5 x 0.9 is a little less than 5.
practice.ans: 0.9 is a little less than 1. Multiplying 5 by 1 keeps it 5, so multiplying by a little less than 1 gives a little less than 5. The product is 4.5.

quiz.q: Which product is greater than 3/5?
Which expression has a product equal to 12?
A plant is 18 cm tall. A second plant is 2/3 as tall as the first. How many centimeters tall is the second plant?
A tree is 3 1/3 meters tall. A building is 4 1/2 times as tall as the tree. How many meters tall is the building?
The letter n stands for a number greater than 1. Which statement about 3/4 x n is true?
A painter mixes 1 3/4 gallons of paint and uses 2/3 of it. How many gallons of paint does she use?
Leo says multiplying always makes a number bigger. Use 10 x 1/2 to explain why he is wrong.
quiz.ans: 10 x 1/2 = 5, which is less than 10. Multiplying by a fraction less than 1 gives a product smaller than the other factor.

lessons.name: Dividing with unit fractions and decimals

practice.h: How many fourths are in 3 wholes?
Split one half into 4 equal parts.
How many groups of 3 tenths are in 12 tenths?
How many halves are in 5?

practice.q: How many 1/3-cup servings are in 4 cups of rice?
practice.h: Each cup has 3 servings.

practice.q: 3 friends share 1/2 of a pizza equally. What fraction of the whole pizza does each friend get?
practice.h: Split one half into 3 equal parts.

practice.q: Explain why 2 / (1/5) = 10.
practice.ans: 1/5 fits into 1 whole 5 times, so it fits into 2 wholes 2 x 5 = 10 times.

quiz.q: A ribbon is 5 yards long. Each bow uses 1/4 yard. How many bows can be made?
Which expression matches "4 children share 1/3 of a pan of brownies equally"?
A 2-liter bottle of juice is poured into cups that each hold 0.25 liter. How many cups can be filled?
Ana says (1/2) / 3 = 1 1/2. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: She multiplied 3 x 1/2 instead of dividing. Splitting 1/2 into 3 equal parts makes each part smaller, so (1/2) / 3 = 1/6.

test.q: Which fraction is the same as 7 / 3?
Which product is less than 9?
A rectangle is 2/3 m long and 3/4 m wide. What is its area?
Which expression shows "half of the sum of 3/4 and 1/8"?
7 pizzas are shared equally by 4 teams. How many pizzas does each team get?
A school has 480 students, and 5/8 of them bring lunch from home. How many students do NOT bring lunch from home?
Each serving of trail mix is 1/4 cup. Mrs. Ito makes 6 cups of trail mix and gives away 15 servings. How many servings are left?
A field is 3/4 mile long and 2/5 mile wide. What is its area in square miles?
Juan buys 2.5 pounds of grapes that cost $1.80 per pound. How many dollars does he pay?
Without multiplying, which statement about 1 1/4 x 36 is true?
A recipe needs 2/3 cup of oil. Sam makes half of the recipe, then doubles that amount. How much oil does he use?
Which expression answers "How many 1/5-meter pieces can be cut from 3 meters of rope"?
Explain why 3/4 x 2/3 is less than 3/4.
test.ans: You are finding 2/3 of 3/4. Taking a fraction less than 1 of a number gives less than the number, so the product (1/2) is less than 3/4.

test.q: Sofia says 6 / (1/2) = 3. Explain her mistake.
test.ans: She found half of 6, which is 6 x 1/2. Dividing by 1/2 asks how many halves are in 6. There are 2 halves in each whole, so 6 / (1/2) = 12.

test.q: Write a word problem for (1/4) / 3 and solve it with a model.
test.ans: 3 friends share 1/4 of a cake equally. How much of the whole cake does each get? Draw a cake cut into fourths and split one fourth into 3 equal parts; each part is 1/12 of the cake.

test.q: A cookie recipe that makes 24 cookies uses 3/4 cup of sugar, 2 1/4 cups of flour and 0.5 pound of butter. The class wants to make 36 cookies. (a) By what number must each amount be multiplied? (b) Find the new amount of sugar, flour and butter. (c) Butter costs $3.60 per pound. How much will the butter cost? (d) The class measures sugar with a 1/8 cup scoop. How many scoops of sugar are needed? Explain why each new amount is greater than the original.
rub: (a) 36 / 24 = 1 1/2; (b) 1 1/8 cups sugar, 3 3/8 cups flour, 0.75 pound butter; (c) 0.75 x 3.60 = $2.70; (d) 1 1/8 / (1/8) = 9 scoops; explains that multiplying by a number greater than 1 makes each amount larger.
All parts correct with a weak explanation, or one small error with clear work.
Two parts correct, or scales by the wrong factor but computes correctly.
Little correct work.

units.name: Module 5: Addition and multiplication with volume and area
units.el: Build prisms with centimeter cubes and tile rectangles with grid paper cut into halves and fourths. Pre-teach "volume", "cubic unit", "base area", "layer", "parallelogram", "rhombus" and "attribute", and keep a labeled quadrilateral family chart on the wall.

lessons.name: Understanding volume with unit cubes

practice.q: Which unit could be used to measure volume?
practice.h: Volume measures how much space a solid takes up.

practice.q: A box is filled with 3 layers of cubes. Each layer has 8 cubes. How many cubes fill the box?
practice.h: Multiply the cubes in one layer by the number of layers.

practice.q: A rectangular prism is built from unit cubes. It is 5 cubes long, 2 cubes wide and 3 cubes tall. What is its volume in cubic units?
practice.h: Find the cubes in one layer first.

practice.q: Why can't volume be measured in square units?
ch: Square units are flat and cannot fill space
practice.h: Think about what a square unit covers and what a cube fills.

practice.q: A cube has edges 3 cm long. How many 1-centimeter cubes fill it?
practice.h: Each layer is 3 by 3, and there are 3 layers.

practice.q: Explain why packing a box with gaps between the cubes gives the wrong volume.
practice.ans: Volume is the number of unit cubes that fill a space with no gaps or overlaps. If there are gaps, the box is not filled, so the count is too small.

quiz.q: A prism has a bottom layer of 6 cubes and is 4 layers tall. What is its volume in cubic units?
The volume of which space is best measured in cubic meters?
ch: the cargo space of a moving truck

quiz.q: A box is 5 cm long, 4 cm wide and 2 cm tall. How many 1-centimeter cubes fill it?
Box A is built from unit cubes 2 by 3 by 4, and Box B is built 1 by 4 by 6. Which statement is true?
ch: Box A has the greater volume
Box B has the greater volume
You cannot tell which is greater

quiz.q: Lia packs a box that is 6 cubes long and 3 cubes wide. It is exactly full after she puts in 36 cubes. How many layers tall is the box?
A cube has a volume of 64 cubic inches. How long is each edge?
Zeke says a box that is 2 by 3 by 4 has a volume of 9 cubic units because 2 + 3 + 4 = 9. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: Volume counts the cubes in layers. Each layer has 2 x 3 = 6 cubes and there are 4 layers, so the volume is 6 x 4 = 24 cubic units. Adding side lengths does not count cubes.

lessons.name: Volume formulas and composite solids

practice.q: Use V = l x w x h. A box is 7 inches long, 4 inches wide and 3 inches tall. What is its volume in cubic inches?
practice.h: Multiply the three dimensions.

practice.q: A box has a base area of 18 square feet and a height of 5 feet. What is its volume in cubic feet?
practice.h: Volume = base area x height.

practice.q: A box has a volume of 60 cubic inches, a length of 5 inches and a width of 3 inches. What is its height in inches?
practice.h: First find the base area, then think: base area x ? = 60.

practice.q: A solid is made of a 4 by 3 by 2 prism and a 2 by 2 by 5 prism. What is its total volume?
practice.h: Find the volume of each prism, then add.

practice.q: An aquarium is 50 cm long, 20 cm wide and 30 cm tall. Water fills it to a depth of 25 cm. How many cubic centimeters of water are in it?
practice.h: Use the water's depth, not the tank's height.

practice.q: Explain why V = b x h works for a rectangular prism.
practice.ans: The base area b tells how many unit cubes fit in one layer, and the height h tells how many layers there are, so b x h counts all the cubes.

quiz.q: A cube has edges 6 m long. What is its volume in cubic meters?
A sandbox 8 feet by 5 feet is filled with sand 2 feet deep. How many cubic feet of sand are in it?
A prism has a volume of 96 cubic cm and a base area of 16 square cm. What is its height in centimeters?
Which set of dimensions gives a volume of 48 cubic units?
A storage unit is made of two boxes stacked together. One is 10 ft by 6 ft by 4 ft and the other is 6 ft by 6 ft by 3 ft. What is the total volume in cubic feet?
A box is 3 by 4 by 5. If every edge length is doubled, how does the volume change?
Tia found the volume of a 10 by 2 by 3 box as 10 x 2 + 3 = 23. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: She added the height instead of multiplying by it. The base has 10 x 2 = 20 cubes and there are 3 layers, so the volume is 20 x 3 = 60 cubic units.

lessons.name: Area with fractional side lengths

practice.q: A rectangle is 3 1/2 feet by 4 feet. What is its area in square feet?
practice.h: Find 3 x 4 and 1/2 x 4, then add.

practice.q: A tile is 2/3 foot by 3/4 foot. What is its area in square feet?
practice.h: Multiply the numerators and the denominators.

practice.q: A garden is 5 1/2 m by 2 1/4 m. What is its area in square meters?
practice.h: Write each side as a fraction greater than 1, or use partial products.

practice.q: Which expression finds the area of a 2 1/2 by 3 1/3 rectangle using partial products?
practice.h: Each part of one side must be multiplied by each part of the other side.

practice.q: A wall is 8 feet wide and 9 1/2 feet tall. It has a door that is 3 feet by 6 2/3 feet. How many square feet of the wall need paint?
practice.h: Find the wall's area and the door's area, then subtract.

practice.q: Explain how tiling a 1 1/2 by 2 1/2 rectangle shows its area.
practice.ans: Whole unit squares cover 1 by 2 = 2 square units. The strips along the edges cover 1 x 1/2 = 1/2 and 1/2 x 2 = 1. The corner piece is 1/2 x 1/2 = 1/4. The total is 3 3/4 square units, the same as 3/2 x 5/2 = 15/4.

quiz.q: A poster is 1 1/2 feet by 2 feet. What is its area in square feet?
A rectangle is 3/5 m by 5/6 m. What is its area in square meters?
A patio is 4 1/2 yards by 6 yards. Tiles cost $8 per square yard. How many dollars do the tiles cost?
Which rectangle has an area of 6 square units?
A square has sides 3/4 inch long. What is its area in square inches?
A rectangle has an area of 10 square feet and a length of 4 feet. What is its width?
Kim says a 2 1/2 by 4 rectangle has an area of 8 1/2 square units because 2 x 4 = 8 and there is 1/2 left. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: She did not multiply the 1/2 by 4. 1/2 x 4 = 2, so the area is 8 + 2 = 10 square units.

lessons.name: Classifying two-dimensional figures

practice.q: Which quadrilateral always has 4 right angles but does not need 4 equal sides?
practice.h: Which shape is named for its right angles?

practice.q: Which statement is always true?
practice.h: Check whether a square has every attribute of a rectangle.

practice.q: A parallelogram has 4 equal sides. What else must it be?
ch: a quadrilateral with no parallel sides
practice.h: Which shape is defined by 4 equal sides?

practice.q: Which attribute do all parallelograms have?
ch: opposite sides are parallel and equal in length
only one pair of parallel sides
practice.h: Think about rectangles, rhombuses and squares, which are all parallelograms.

practice.q: How many pairs of parallel sides does a parallelogram have?
practice.h: Look at both pairs of opposite sides.

practice.q: Explain why a square is also a rhombus.
practice.ans: A rhombus is a quadrilateral with 4 equal sides. A square has 4 equal sides, so it is a rhombus. It also has 4 right angles, which makes it a special rhombus.

quiz.q: Which shape is a parallelogram with 4 right angles?
ch: rhombus that is not a square
trapezoid that is not a parallelogram

quiz.q: Which statement is NOT always true?
A quadrilateral has two pairs of equal sides next to each other and no parallel sides. What is it?
Which name describes a figure that is both a rectangle and a rhombus?
ch: kite that is not a rhombus

quiz.q: A quadrilateral has angles of 90, 90, 90 and x degrees. The angles of a quadrilateral add to 360 degrees. What is x?
Which attribute does every rhombus have?
ch: exactly one pair of parallel sides

quiz.q: Max says a rectangle cannot be a parallelogram because parallelograms have slanted sides. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: A parallelogram is any quadrilateral with 2 pairs of parallel sides. A rectangle has 2 pairs of parallel sides, so it is a parallelogram; its sides just meet at right angles.

test.q: A box is 6 cm by 4 cm by 5 cm. What is its volume in cubic centimeters?
A cube has edges 5 inches long. What is its volume in cubic inches?
Which unit measures volume?
A rectangle is 2 1/2 m by 6 m. What is its area in square meters?
A prism has a base area of 24 square inches and a height of 7 inches. What is its volume in cubic inches?
A rectangle is 3/4 foot by 2/5 foot. What is its area in square feet?
Which statement about squares is always true?
ch: Every square is a rhombus and a rectangle
Every square has no right angles
A square has only one pair of parallel sides
A square is never a parallelogram

test.q: Which dimensions give a volume of 36 cubic units?
A solid is made of a 5 by 2 by 2 prism and a 3 by 2 by 4 prism. What is its total volume?
Which shape is a parallelogram with 4 equal sides and no right angles?
ch: trapezoid that is not a parallelogram

test.q: A pool is 12 m long, 5 m wide and 2 m deep. It is filled with water halfway to the top. How many cubic meters of water are in it?
A garden bed is 3 1/2 feet by 8 feet. One bag of soil covers 4 square feet. How many bags are needed to cover the bed?
A box is 10 inches long, 6 inches wide and 4 inches tall. How many 2-inch cubes fit inside it?
A room is 4 1/2 m by 3 1/3 m. Carpet costs $20 per square meter. How many dollars does the carpet cost?
A prism has a volume of 90 cubic cm. Its length is 6 cm and its width is 5 cm. What is its height?
Box A is 4 by 5 by 6. Box B has the same base as Box A but twice the height. Which statement is true?
ch: Box B's volume is 240 cubic units, twice Box A's
Box B's volume is 120 cubic units
Box B's volume is 480 cubic units
Box B's volume is 8 times Box A's

test.q: Which expression finds the volume of a solid made of a 3 by 4 by 5 prism and a 3 by 4 by 2 prism?
The angles of a quadrilateral add to 360 degrees. A parallelogram has angles of 70, 110, 70 and x degrees. What is x?
Explain why the volume of a box can be found by multiplying the area of its base by its height.
test.ans: The base area tells how many unit cubes fit in one layer, and the height tells how many layers stack up, so base area x height counts every cube.

test.q: Kai says a rhombus is always a square. Give an example that shows he is wrong.
test.ans: A rhombus with angles of 60 and 120 degrees has 4 equal sides but no right angles, so it is not a square.

test.q: Use partial products to find the area of a 3 1/2 by 2 1/2 rectangle. Explain each part.
test.ans: 3 x 2 = 6, 3 x 1/2 = 1 1/2, 1/2 x 2 = 1 and 1/2 x 1/2 = 1/4. Adding the parts gives 8 3/4 square units, which matches 7/2 x 5/2 = 35/4.

test.q: The garden club has exactly 72 cubic feet of soil to fill a new rectangular planter box that is 2 feet tall. (a) What must the base area be? (b) Give two different whole-number lengths and widths for the base. (c) The box's longer side must fit along a wall that is 10 feet long. Which of your designs fit? (d) If the club makes the box 3 feet tall instead and uses all the soil, what is the new base area? Explain why the base area changes.
rub: (a) 72 / 2 = 36 square feet; (b) two of 1 by 36, 2 by 18, 3 by 12, 4 by 9, 6 by 6; (c) only designs with both sides 10 feet or less (4 by 9 or 6 by 6) fit; (d) 72 / 3 = 24 square feet, because more layers means fewer cubes are needed in each layer.
All parts correct with a gap in the explanation, or one small error.
Two parts correct, or uses addition instead of multiplication in one part.
Little correct work.

units.name: Module 6: Problem solving with the coordinate plane
units.el: Tape a coordinate grid on the floor and have students walk to points ("over, then up"). Pre-teach "origin", "axis", "coordinate", "ordered pair", "parallel" and "perpendicular", and post the frame "Start at the origin, move ___ right and ___ up."

lessons.name: Coordinate systems and plotting points

practice.q: In the ordered pair (4, 2), what does the 4 tell you?
ch: how far to move along the x-axis from the origin
how far to move along the y-axis from the origin
the number of points on the line
practice.h: The first number is the x-coordinate.

practice.q: What are the coordinates of the origin?
practice.h: The origin is where the two axes meet.

practice.q: Start at the origin, move 3 units right and 5 units up. Which point are you at?
practice.h: Write the move right first, then the move up.

practice.q: Point A is at (6, 4). What is its y-coordinate?
practice.h: The y-coordinate is the second number.

practice.q: Which point is on the x-axis?
practice.h: A point on the x-axis has not moved up at all.

practice.q: Explain the difference between the points (2, 6) and (6, 2).
practice.ans: (2, 6) is 2 units right and 6 units up from the origin, and (6, 2) is 6 units right and 2 units up. The order of the coordinates matters, so they are different points.

quiz.q: Which ordered pair names the point 0 units right and 4 units up from the origin?
Point B is at (9, 3). How many units is it from the y-axis?
Start at (2, 3). Move 3 units right and 1 unit up. Where are you now?
The points (1, 5) and (8, 5) are on a horizontal line. How many units apart are they?
Which point is farther from the x-axis, (3, 8) or (8, 3)?
ch: They are the same distance from the x-axis

quiz.q: A point in the first quadrant is 5 units from the x-axis and 2 units from the y-axis. What is its x-coordinate?
Rosa plotted (4, 1) by moving up 4 and then right 1. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: The first coordinate is the x-coordinate, so she should move 4 units right first and then 1 unit up. By going up 4 and right 1 she plotted (1, 4).

lessons.name: Numerical patterns and graphing rules

practice.q: A pattern starts at 0 and adds 3: 0, 3, 6, 9. What is the next number?
practice.h: Add 3 to the last term.

practice.q: Pattern A starts at 0 and adds 2. Pattern B starts at 0 and adds 4. Which statement about matching terms is true?
ch: Each term in B is twice the matching term in A
Each term in B is 2 more than the matching term in A
Each term in A is twice the matching term in B
practice.h: List the first four terms of each pattern and compare.

practice.q: A pattern starts at 0 and adds 5. The first term is 0. What is the fifth term?
practice.h: List the terms: 0, 5, and so on.

practice.q: The rule is "y is 3 more than x". Which point follows the rule?
practice.h: Add 3 to the x-coordinate. Do you get the y-coordinate?

practice.q: The rule is "multiply x by 2 to get y". What is y when x is 7?
practice.h: Use the rule on 7.

practice.q: Pattern A is 0, 3, 6, 9 and pattern B is 0, 6, 12, 18. Describe how the patterns are related and write the ordered pairs (A, B).
practice.ans: Each term in pattern B is 2 times the matching term in pattern A. The ordered pairs are (0, 0), (3, 6), (6, 12) and (9, 18).

quiz.q: A pattern starts at 1 and adds 4: 1, 5, 9. What is the 5th term?
Which ordered pairs follow the rule "y is x times 3"?
A line passes through (0, 1), (1, 3), (2, 5) and (3, 7). Following the same pattern, what is the y-coordinate when x is 6?
Pattern A is 0, 4, 8, 12 and pattern B is 0, 2, 4, 6. Which statement is true?
ch: Each term in A is 2 times the matching term in B
Each term in A is 2 more than the matching term in B
Each term in B is 2 times the matching term in A
The patterns have the same rule

quiz.q: A plant is 2 cm tall and grows 3 cm each week. How many centimeters tall is it after 8 weeks?
The points (0, 0), (1, 4) and (2, 8) lie on a line. Which point is also on that line?
Dee says (2, 8) follows the rule "y is 4 more than x" because 2 x 4 = 8. Explain her mistake.
quiz.ans: "4 more than" means add 4, so y should be 2 + 4 = 6. The point (2, 8) follows the rule "y is 4 times x" instead.

lessons.name: Drawing figures and finding lengths on the coordinate plane

practice.q: A rectangle has corners at (1, 1), (6, 1), (6, 4) and (1, 4). How many units long is its horizontal side?
practice.h: Subtract the x-coordinates of two corners on the same horizontal side.

practice.q: A rectangle has corners at (1, 1), (6, 1), (6, 4) and (1, 4). What is its area in square units?
practice.h: Find the length and the width first.

practice.q: Three corners of a square are (2, 2), (5, 2) and (5, 5). What is the fourth corner?
practice.h: Sketch the three points. Which corner is missing?

practice.q: A rectangle has corners at (0, 0), (8, 0), (8, 3) and (0, 3). What is its perimeter in units?
practice.h: Find the length and width, then add all four sides.

practice.q: A line goes through (3, 0) and (3, 7). Which statement describes the line?
ch: It is parallel to the y-axis
It is parallel to the x-axis
It slants up to the right
practice.h: Both points have the same x-coordinate.

practice.q: Explain how you know a line through (1, 4) and (9, 4) is parallel to the x-axis.
practice.ans: Both points have a y-coordinate of 4, so every point on the line is 4 units above the x-axis. The line stays the same distance from the x-axis, so it is parallel to it.

quiz.q: The points (2, 3) and (2, 10) are plotted. How many units apart are they?
A rectangle has corners at (2, 1), (7, 1), (7, 5) and (2, 5). What is its area in square units?
Which point makes a rectangle with (1, 2), (1, 6) and (4, 6)?
How are the segment from (0, 2) to (5, 2) and the segment from (0, 6) to (5, 6) related?
On a park map, 1 unit stands for 10 meters. The pond is at (3, 2) and the slide is at (3, 9). How many meters apart are they?
Which pair of points makes a segment perpendicular to the segment from (1, 1) to (1, 6)?
Will says the rectangle with corners (1, 1), (5, 1), (5, 3) and (1, 3) has an area of 6 square units because 5 + 1 = 6. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: He added coordinates instead of finding side lengths. The length is 5 - 1 = 4 units and the width is 3 - 1 = 2 units, so the area is 4 x 2 = 8 square units.

lessons.name: Problem solving with the coordinate plane

practice.q: A town map shows the school at (2, 3) and the library at (2, 8). Each unit is 1 block. How many blocks apart are they?
practice.h: The x-coordinates match, so subtract the y-coordinates.

practice.q: A taxi charges $3 plus $2 for each mile. Its graph of (miles, cost) includes (1, 5), (2, 7) and (3, 9). How many dollars does a 6-mile ride cost?
practice.h: Each extra mile adds $2.

practice.q: A graph of a bike ride shows the points (1, 12), (2, 24) and (3, 36) as (hours, miles). Which rule fits the graph?
practice.h: How do the miles change each hour?

practice.q: Leo walks from (1, 1) to (1, 5), then to (6, 5). Each unit is 100 meters. How many meters does he walk?
practice.h: Find each part of the walk in units, then convert.

practice.q: Jo has $10 saved and saves $5 more each week. Which point shows (week, dollars) for week 4?
practice.h: Start at 10 and add 5 four times.

practice.q: Explain how a graph of (weeks, dollars saved) can help you predict savings for a later week.
practice.ans: The points follow a rule and line up, so you can continue the pattern or extend the line to read the number of dollars for a later week.

quiz.q: Cupcakes cost $2 each. A graph shows (number of cupcakes, cost). What is the cost of 9 cupcakes, in dollars?
A tank has 50 liters of water and drains 4 liters each minute. A graph of (minutes, liters) includes (0, 50), (1, 46) and (2, 42). How many liters are left after 10 minutes?
A delivery robot starts at (0, 0). It moves 4 units right, 3 units up and then 2 more units right. Where is it?
Maya's home is at (2, 7), Sam's home is at (9, 7) and the school is at (9, 1). Maya walks to Sam's home, and then they walk together to school. Each unit is 1 block. How many blocks does Maya walk?
Pattern A (x-coordinates) is 0, 1, 2, 3 and pattern B (y-coordinates) is 0, 3, 6, 9. Which point would be graphed next?
A garden map has corners at (0, 0), (12, 0), (12, 5) and (0, 5), and each unit is 1 foot. How many feet of fence go all the way around the garden?
Ty says the point (3, 9) on a graph of (hours, dollars) means $3 for 9 hours. Explain his mistake.
quiz.ans: The first coordinate is hours and the second is dollars, so (3, 9) means $9 after 3 hours. He switched the order.

test.q: Which ordered pair names the point 6 units right of the origin and 2 units up?
Which point is on the y-axis?
What is the x-coordinate of the point (8, 5)?
The points (4, 2) and (4, 11) are plotted. How many units apart are they?
The rule is "multiply x by 4 to get y". What is y when x is 6?
A pattern starts at 3 and adds 6. The first term is 3. What is the 6th term?
Pattern A is 0, 5, 10, 15 and pattern B is 0, 10, 20, 30. Which ordered pair (A, B) is on their graph?
Three corners of a rectangle are (2, 1), (7, 1) and (7, 4). What is the fourth corner?
A rectangle has corners at (0, 0), (9, 0), (9, 4) and (0, 4). What is its area in square units?
Which line is parallel to the x-axis?
Start at (5, 6). Move 2 units left and 3 units down. Where are you now?
On a map, 1 unit stands for 5 miles. Town A is at (1, 2) and Town B is at (1, 10). How many miles apart are the towns?
A pool fills at 30 liters per minute, starting empty. A graph shows (minutes, liters). How many liters are in the pool after 12 minutes?
A rectangle on a grid has corners at (1, 2), (11, 2), (11, 8) and (1, 8). Each unit stands for 2 feet. What is the area of the real rectangle in square feet?
A phone plan costs $10 plus $5 for each gigabyte. Its graph of (gigabytes, cost) includes (1, 15) and (2, 20). How many dollars does the plan cost for 7 gigabytes?
Which point is NOT on the line that follows the rule "y is 2 more than x"?
A point has an x-coordinate that is 3 times its y-coordinate. Which point could it be?
Which segment is perpendicular to the segment from (2, 4) to (8, 4)?
Explain why the point (5, 0) is on the x-axis.
test.ans: Its y-coordinate is 0, so it is 0 units up from the x-axis. It sits on the x-axis, 5 units to the right of the origin.

test.q: Nia says the distance from (2, 3) to (2, 9) is 12 units because 3 + 9 = 12. Explain her mistake.
test.ans: The points are on a vertical line, so the distance is the difference of the y-coordinates, not the sum: 9 - 3 = 6 units.

test.q: Pattern A starts at 0 and adds 2. Pattern B starts at 0 and adds 6. Write the first four terms of each pattern, form the ordered pairs (A, B), and describe the relationship between the patterns.
test.ans: A: 0, 2, 4, 6. B: 0, 6, 12, 18. Ordered pairs: (0, 0), (2, 6), (4, 12), (6, 18). Each term in B is 3 times the matching term in A.

test.q: A city is planning a park on a coordinate grid where each unit stands for 10 meters. The playground is a rectangle with corners at (1, 1), (5, 1), (5, 4) and (1, 4). (a) Plot the playground and find its perimeter in meters. (b) Find its area in square meters. (c) A fountain is at (8, 4). A straight path runs from the playground corner at (5, 4) to the fountain. How long is the path in meters? (d) A garden the same size as the playground will be placed 6 units directly above it. Give the four corners of the garden. Show your work and explain how you used the coordinates.
rub: (a) sides of 40 m and 30 m, perimeter 140 m; (b) 40 x 30 = 1,200 square meters; (c) 3 units = 30 m; (d) (1, 7), (5, 7), (5, 10) and (1, 10); coordinates used correctly with clear explanations.
All parts correct with gaps in explanation, or one small error with clear work.
Two parts correct, or forgets the scale in several parts.
Little correct work.

math|6.about: Sixth grade connects ratio and rate reasoning to multiplication and division, completes division of fractions and fluency with multi-digit decimals, extends the number line to negative numbers and the coordinate plane, writes and solves one-variable expressions and equations, applies area, surface area and volume to real problems, and begins statistical thinking about variability.
std: Use ratio and rate reasoning to solve real-world and mathematical problems, including tables, tape diagrams, unit rates and percents.
Interpret and compute quotients of fractions, and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions.
Understand a rational number as a point on the number line and extend number line and coordinate axes to negative numbers.
Write, read and evaluate expressions in which letters stand for numbers.
Solve real-world and mathematical problems by writing and solving equations of the form x + p = q and px = q.
Find the volume of a right rectangular prism with fractional edge lengths and solve real-world problems.
Summarize numerical data sets in relation to their context using measures of center and variability.

units.name: Module 1: Ratios and unit rates
units.el: Post a word bank with picture examples (ratio, for every, per, each, unit rate, percent) and model reading "3:5" aloud as "3 to 5" and "for every 3 there are 5".

lessons.name: Ratios and equivalent ratios

practice.q: A class has 12 girls and 15 boys. What is the ratio of boys to girls?
practice.h: The order of the words tells you the order of the numbers.

practice.q: Which ratio is equivalent to 3:5?
practice.h: Multiply both numbers in the ratio by the same number.

practice.q: A juice mix uses 2 cups of mango juice for every 7 cups of water. How many cups of water go with 6 cups of mango juice?
practice.h: How many times bigger is 6 than 2?

practice.q: In a garden, the ratio of tomato plants to pepper plants is 4:3. There are 28 plants in all. How many tomato plants are there?
practice.h: There are 4 + 3 = 7 parts in all. How many plants are in one part?

practice.q: A team has 5 forwards for every 2 goalies. Which could be the numbers of forwards and goalies on the team?
practice.h: Check whether both numbers were multiplied by the same number.

practice.q: Explain what the ratio 5:2 means for a team that has 5 forwards for every 2 goalies. Give one other pair of numbers with the same ratio.
practice.ans: For every 5 forwards there are 2 goalies. For example, 10 forwards and 4 goalies keep the same ratio because both numbers are doubled.

quiz.q: A bag has 8 red beads and 5 blue beads. What is the ratio of blue beads to all the beads?
Which pair of ratios is equivalent?
Paint is mixed with 3 parts blue to 2 parts white. Leila uses 18 liters of blue. How many liters of white does she use?
The ratio of adults to children on a field trip is 2:9. There are 44 people on the trip. How many children are there?
A recipe uses flour and sugar in a ratio of 5:2. Which amounts keep the same ratio?
